title: Pullman's glasshouses rise across 18th Street
items: The open lawn east of Prairie at 18th Street now holds the Pullman estate's glasshouses, placed as the 1911 fire-insurance map draws them: a tall pavilion with a raised lantern, a long range running south from it, and a second range running east to a rounded glass end.
A two-storey brick lodge stands where the two ranges meet.
Every height, roof and pane is a reconstruction from the project's conservatory kit, and the cards say so. Matching them to the 1890s photographs comes next.
